title: Axel Oxenstierna → the regency council (Kungl. Maj:t och Rådet), Swedish despatch with a numeric nomenclator, deciphered between the lines
correspondents: Axel Oxenstierna → the Swedish regency council
shelfmark: Riksarkivet, Skrivelser till konungen, Kristinas tid, SE/RA/1133/1133.08/10 (Axel Oxenstierna 2/12 1633-1/3 1634), fol. 230-231
folio_note: image series R0001375, images 246-247 (old fol. 230-231): about 25 lines of cipher on 246 and 20 on 247, numbers of 1-4 digits with doubled letters (rr, aa, nn, uu), every cipher line struck through and deciphered in Swedish above it
status: Viewed 11 Nov 2026 at 2400 px: fully glossed by the chancery, so already read; not on the repo ledgers (known.py: no hits). Listed as a cipher/plaintext pair for key rebuilding, not as an open text. DECODE not searched for this leaf.
why: A long matched cipher/plaintext pair in the chancellor's own code of 1634, useful for rebuilding the key behind other Oxenstierna-era letters (DECODE R4282-R4341 hold Chifferklaver keys).
score_note: Scored from the scan during the 11 Nov 2026 Riksarkivet papers sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_riksarkivet_papers/); viewed
